name: treeno
description: Long-term memory for your AI agent in your Treeno notes: conversation journal, facts, decisions and to-dos.

interface.shortDescription: Long-term memory in your Treeno notes
interface.longDescription: Keeps a short journal of your conversations, remembers facts about you, decisions, important details and to-dos in the "🧠 AI memory" folder of your Treeno notes, and looks them up in later conversations. You can read and edit everything in the Treeno app.
